title: 安全检查与隐患整改
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/005_安全检查与隐患整改.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/005_安全检查与隐患整改/src.py

points.K3: 日常自查：开工收工查一遍
points.K5: 节假日和恶劣天气前检查
points.K6: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患
points.K9: 重大隐患先停用、立即报
points.K10: 整改闭环：定人定时，复查销号
points.K13: 记录的保存期限与数字化归档
points.K14: 检查是彩排，天天经得起查

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣拿着放大镜和空白检查表，站在实验室门口招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a magnifying glass and a blank checklist at a lab door and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲安全检查与隐患整改。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 一个圆形循环箭头，上面四个图标：放大镜、电话、扳手、勾
shots.prompt_en: A circular loop of arrows with four icons on it: a magnifying glass, a phone, a wrench, and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 查得出、报得上、改得掉、验得过。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研在实验台角落发现两个插线板串在一起，旁边一个气瓶没有固定
shots.prompt_en: In a lab corner the female graduate student notices two power strips plugged into each other and an unsecured gas cylinder nearby.
shots.narration: 小研发现：插线板串接，气瓶没固定。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰摆摆手，指着日历
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waves it off casually and points at a wall calendar.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：记下来，等下周例会再说吧。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head seriously in front of the lab corner.
shots.narration: 隐患可不会等你开完会。

shots.section_title: 检查就是主动找隐患
shots.scene: 小研拿着放大镜在实验室里仔细查看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks through the lab looking carefully with a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 巡查，就是主动去找隐患。

shots.section_title: 检查就是主动找隐患
shots.scene: 找到的问题旁出现灯泡和扳手
shots.prompt_en: A found problem icon with a light bulb and a wrench appearing beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 找到问题，再想好怎么改。

shots.section_title: 检查就是主动找隐患
shots.scene: 老李检查通风柜和设备，在空白卡片上记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a fume hood and an instrument, writing on a blank maintenance card.
shots.narration: 设备设施也要定期检查、按时维护。

shots.section_title: 检查就是主动找隐患
shots.scene: 检查图标嵌进一个齿轮组
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon fitting into a set of turning gears. No people.
shots.narration: 定期巡查，是安全管理的重要一环。

shots.section_title: 三级检查：自查、学院查、学校查
shots.scene: 三层图标：实验室、学院、学校，各有一个放大镜
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked icons, a lab room, a department building and a university building, each with a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 高校实行三级安全检查。
overlay: 三级检查：自查、学院查、学校查

shots.section_title: 三级检查：自查、学院查、学校查
shots.scene: 小研拿检查表在本室自查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student does a self-check in her own lab with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 实验室天天自查。

shots.section_title: 三级检查：自查、学院查、学校查
shots.scene: 王老师带队到各实验室巡查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads a small team walking from lab to lab on inspection.
shots.narration: 学院定期检查，学校组织专项检查。

shots.section_title: 日常自查：开工收工查一遍
shots.scene: 阿杰早上进门，看一眼墙上的空白自查表
shots.prompt_en: In the morning the young male student enters the lab and glances at a blank self-check sheet on the wall.
shots.narration: 等别人来查，不如自己先查。
overlay: 日常自查：开工收工查一遍

shots.section_title: 日常自查：开工收工查一遍
shots.scene: 阿杰收工前查看通道、线缆、废液桶和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: Before leaving, the young male student checks the walkway, cables, a waste container and the fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 每天收工前，按清单查一遍。

shots.section_title: 日常自查：开工收工查一遍
shots.scene: 阿杰顺手把地上的线缆收好
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a loose cable from the floor and coils it neatly.
shots.narration: 小问题，当场就处理。

shots.section_title: 日常自查：开工收工查一遍
shots.scene: 时钟图标转了几圈，小研多次走过实验室
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon spins around while the female graduate student walks through the lab several times.
shots.narration: 现场一直在变，一天要多看几次。

shots.section_title: 逐级累积的检查节奏
shots.scene: 日历上一周、一季、一年依次被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A calendar where a week, a quarter, and a whole year get circled one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 自查，要一层层累积起来。

shots.section_title: 逐级累积的检查节奏
shots.scene: 四级台阶：周、季、外部、年度
shots.prompt_en: Four ascending steps with icons: a small checklist, a thicker checklist, a visitor badge, and a big folder. No people.
shots.narration: 每周巡一遍，每季全面自查。

shots.section_title: 逐级累积的检查节奏
shots.scene: 隔壁学院的老师受邀来看，王老师陪同
shots.prompt_en: A visiting teacher from another department, invited, looks around the lab with the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 定期请外面的人来看看。

shots.section_title: 逐级累积的检查节奏
shots.scene: 模拟检查查出的问题被一项项改掉打勾
shots.prompt_en: Problems found in a mock inspection are fixed one by one and ticked green. No people.
shots.narration: 模拟检查查出的问题，都当真去改。

shots.section_title: 节假日和恶劣天气前检查
shots.scene: 日历上红色假期和乌云闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with red holiday dates next to a dark cloud with lightning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 节假日和恶劣天气前，要专门检查。
overlay: 节假日和恶劣天气前检查

shots.section_title: 节假日和恶劣天气前检查
shots.scene: 小研关窗户，检查地漏排水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes a window and checks the floor drain.
shots.narration: 关好门窗，查查排水。

shots.section_title: 节假日和恶劣天气前检查
shots.scene: 小研关闭气瓶总阀，拔掉不用设备的插头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the main valve of a gas cylinder and unplugs an unused instrument.
shots.narration: 关闭气瓶，切断不必要的电源。

shots.section_title: 节假日和恶劣天气前检查
shots.scene: 冰箱和长时运行设备旁贴着空白值守联系卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank contact card is taped onto a refrigerator and a long-running instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 必须运行的设备，留好联系人。

shots.section_title: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患
shots.scene: 小研拿着分成五栏的空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank checklist divided into five sections.
shots.narration: 拿好检查清单，一项一项查。
overlay: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患

shots.section_title: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患
shots.scene: 【实拍】实验室角落：气瓶用链条固定在墙边，插线板单独接在墙插上（规范状态，无品牌标识）
shots.prompt_en: A lab corner with a gas cylinder secured to the wall by a chain and a single power strip plugged directly into the wall outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板不串接，气瓶要固定好。

shots.section_title: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患
shots.scene: 试剂柜里分类摆放的试剂和贴签的废液桶
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet with reagents sorted on separate shelves, and labeled waste containers on a tray. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品分类存放，废液贴签、不倒下水。

shots.section_title: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患
shots.scene: 台账本和柜里的瓶子用连线对上
shots.prompt_en: A blank ledger book linked by lines to bottles in a locked cabinet, each line ending in a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 管控化学品，账物要相符。

shots.section_title: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患
shots.scene: 柜子后面、桌下的隐患被手电照亮
shots.prompt_en: A flashlight beam reveals hidden problems behind a cabinet and under a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 隐患可能藏得深，柜后桌下都要看。

shots.section_title: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患
shots.scene: 清单图标旁边是一双看的眼睛
shots.prompt_en: A checklist icon next to a pair of watchful eyes. No people.
shots.narration: 清单只是起点，平时也要多看多查。

shots.section_title: 检查看现场，也看记录
shots.scene: 王老师翻看空白的安全手册和培训记录
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator flips through a blank safety manual and blank training records.
shots.narration: 检查看现场，也一样样核对记录。

shots.section_title: 检查看现场，也看记录
shots.scene: 王老师单独问阿杰问题，阿杰认真回答
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator asks the young male student a question privately; he answers carefully.
shots.narration: 还会单独问问实验室里的人。

shots.section_title: 检查看现场，也看记录
shots.scene: 检查表上不符合项被红笔圈出
shots.prompt_en: Non-conforming items on a blank checklist are circled in red pen. No people.
shots.narration: 审核就是找出不符合、没执行的地方。

shots.section_title: 发现隐患立即报告
shots.scene: 阿杰看见有人违规，拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sees an unsafe situation and picks up the phone right away.
shots.narration: 看到违规或不安全情况，立即报告。

shots.section_title: 发现隐患立即报告
shots.scene: 电话连到老周
shots.prompt_en: A phone call line connects the young male student to the older man, who listens attentively.
shots.narration: 报告导师或实验室负责人。

shots.section_title: 发现隐患立即报告
shots.scene: 闭上眼睛走过的小人被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a person walking past a hazard with eyes closed, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要视而不见，不要等出了事。

shots.section_title: 发现隐患立即报告
shots.scene: 组会上小研分享一次险情，大家点头
shots.prompt_en: At a group meeting the female graduate student shares a near-miss story; others nod.
shots.narration: 险情分享出来，别人就不再踩坑。

shots.section_title: 重大隐患先停用、立即报
shots.scene: 隐患图标分成两堆：一般和重大，重大的标红
shots.prompt_en: Hazard icons sorted into two piles: a small yellow pile and a red pile with an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 隐患有一般和重大之分。
overlay: 重大隐患先停用、立即报

shots.section_title: 重大隐患先停用、立即报
shots.scene: 记事本被打叉，红色警报灯亮起
shots.prompt_en: A notebook with a clock icon crossed out; a red alarm light switches on. No people.
shots.narration: 重大隐患不能等例会。

shots.section_title: 重大隐患先停用、立即报
shots.scene: 老周关停设备，门上贴封条
shots.prompt_en: The older man switches off an instrument and tapes the lab door with barrier tape.
shots.narration: 先停用设备、停止实验，立即报告。

shots.section_title: 重大隐患先停用、立即报
shots.scene: 整改后王老师复查，撕掉封条
shots.prompt_en: After the fix, the safety administrator re-inspects and removes the barrier tape with a green check.
shots.narration: 整改合格，才能恢复使用。

shots.section_title: 整改闭环：定人定时，复查销号
shots.scene: 一张空白整改单，三个图标：人、时钟、扳手
shots.prompt_en: A blank rectification form with three icons: a person, a clock, and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 查出隐患，开整改单。
overlay: 整改闭环：定人定时，复查销号

shots.section_title: 整改闭环：定人定时，复查销号
shots.scene: 放大镜沿着裂缝往下找到树根
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass follows a crack down to a hidden root underneath. No people.
shots.narration: 先找根本原因，再采取纠正措施。

shots.section_title: 整改闭环：定人定时，复查销号
shots.scene: 小雪球滚成大雪球的图标
shots.prompt_en: A small snowball rolling downhill and growing into a huge snowball. No people.
shots.narration: 小问题不从根上改，会越滚越大。

shots.section_title: 整改闭环：定人定时，复查销号
shots.scene: 王老师复查后在整改单上打勾销号
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator re-checks the fix and stamps a big green check on the rectification form.
shots.narration: 改完复查，问题不再发生才销号。

shots.section_title: 整改闭环：定人定时，复查销号
shots.scene: 整改单上写着完成日期栏，按时回复
shots.prompt_en: The rectification form with a date box filled and an arrow returning it on time to the department icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按时回复，写明完成日期。

shots.section_title: 发现问题是收获
shots.scene: 一摞查出的问题卡片变成一张柱状图
shots.prompt_en: A stack of found-problem cards transforms into a bar chart with one tall bar. No people.
shots.narration: 自己查出问题，不是失败是收获。

shots.section_title: 发现问题是收获
shots.scene: 柱状图最高一栏是培训记录图标，指向培训系统齿轮
shots.prompt_en: The tallest bar shows a training record icon, with an arrow pointing to a gear representing the training system. No people.
shots.narration: 汇总看趋势，从系统上改。

shots.section_title: 发现问题是收获
shots.scene: 检查表图标变成一只伸出的援手
shots.prompt_en: A checklist icon turns into a helping hand. No people.
shots.narration: 检查是帮手，不是负担。

shots.section_title: 检查要记录、贴标识
shots.scene: 小研在空白检查记录上签名
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs a blank inspection record on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 检查结果要记下来，签名留存。

shots.section_title: 检查要记录、贴标识
shots.scene: 【实拍】设备侧面贴着绿色检查合格标签特写（标签内容空白或打码，无品牌）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a green inspection tag attached to the side of an instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 合格的贴合格标识，按期复查。

shots.section_title: 检查要记录、贴标识
shots.scene: 坏了的设备挂上红色禁用牌，被推去维修
shots.prompt_en: A faulty instrument gets a red out-of-service tag and is wheeled away for repair. No people.
shots.narration: 不合格的挂禁用牌，送去维修。

shots.section_title: 检查要记录、贴标识
shots.scene: 领用登记本、仪器使用记录本
shots.prompt_en: A blank chemical sign-out logbook and a blank instrument usage logbook side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 领用、使用、检查台账，如实及时填。

shots.section_title: 记录的保存期限与数字化归档
shots.scene: 多年前的空白档案盒被从柜子里取出
shots.prompt_en: An old blank archive box is taken out from a tall cabinet, with dust and a calendar showing many years. No people.
shots.narration: 有的记录，多年后还可能被调阅。
overlay: 记录的保存期限与数字化归档

shots.section_title: 记录的保存期限与数字化归档
shots.scene: 接触记录和体检报告两个图标，挂着长时钟
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, an exposure record sheet and a health check report, with a long hourglass beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 接触和体检记录，要长期保存。

shots.section_title: 记录的保存期限与数字化归档
shots.scene: 乱塞的文件柜被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An overstuffed messy filing cabinet with papers spilling out, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 保存期限按国家和学校规定执行。

shots.section_title: 记录的保存期限与数字化归档
shots.scene: 电脑屏幕上空白的文件夹树，一点就调出
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen showing a blank folder tree; a click instantly opens a record. No people.
shots.narration: 建好电子档案，要什么都能调出。

shots.section_title: 检查是彩排，天天经得起查
shots.scene: 舞台彩排的图标，幕布半开
shots.prompt_en: A theater stage with the curtain half open and a rehearsal spotlight. No people.
shots.narration: 把检查当彩排，不是正式演出。
overlay: 检查是彩排，天天经得起查

shots.section_title: 检查是彩排，天天经得起查
shots.scene: 突击补材料的慌乱画面被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A frantic pile of papers being rushed together, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 听说要查才突击，不可取。

shots.section_title: 检查是彩排，天天经得起查
shots.scene: 整洁的实验室，制度、记录、设备标识都在位
shots.prompt_en: A tidy lab where current blank procedures, logbooks and equipment tags are all in place. No people.
shots.narration: 制度现行，记录齐全，设备标识清楚。

shots.section_title: 检查是彩排，天天经得起查
shots.scene: 王老师突然来访，大家照常工作
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator drops by unannounced; everyone keeps working calmly and normally.
shots.narration: 突击检查来了，也一切照常。

shots.section_title: 如实迎检，不补造记录
shots.scene: 阿杰把东西往柜子里藏的画面被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of hiding items in a cabinet before an inspection, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 检查前突击藏东西，不可取。

shots.section_title: 如实迎检，不补造记录
shots.scene: 补签名的笔被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pen back-signing old blank records, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 记录不补签，不造假。

shots.section_title: 如实迎检，不补造记录
shots.scene: 阿杰回答不上来，翻开手册查找
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, unsure of an answer, opens the blank manual to look it up honestly.
shots.narration: 检查时如实说明，不知道就去查。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 循环箭头：查、报、改、验
shots.prompt_en: The circular loop of arrows with the magnifying glass, phone, wrench and check mark icons.
shots.narration: 天天自查，层层检查，节前专查。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 红色重大隐患图标和整改单
shots.prompt_en: A red major hazard icon next to a blank rectification form with a green check.
shots.narration: 隐患立即报，重大先停，整改要闭环。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 签名的记录和电子档案
shots.prompt_en: A signed blank record next to a computer folder icon.
shots.narration: 如实记录，平时就经得起查。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the magnifying glass in hand.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲安全制度与管理体系。
